subject: [hw] V33 start: n2vfs + stdio/time/exit shims
body: V33 started (shim/n2vfs.c, shim/n2shim_stdio.c, shim/test_v33). Implementing the 27 stdio imports: guest fd table from 100, /dev devices via n2vfs_register, read-only virtual /proc and /sys files, per-thread guest errno, FILE* 3..63, log callback, clock_gettime/gettimeofday, exit/abort/__stack_chk_fail -> stop_request (never host exit). Test command will be: bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v33/run_tests.sh
